Genotype calling

call_genotypes.Rd

call_genotypes() calls genotypes from the SNP probes on the array and detects outlying observations. A mixture model (three Beta distributions representing the genotypes AA, AB and BB, and one uniform distribution representing outliers) is fitted to the beta-values of all SNP probes. Either predefined model parameters are used (default), or the parameters are learned from the data via the EM algorithm. Subsequently, the a-posteriori probabilities of each genotype and of being an outlier are computed for every SNP observation.

snp_outliers() summarizes the outlier probabilities per sample as the average log2 odds of being an outlier across all SNP probes. Samples with a score greater than -4 should be flagged as they are likely contaminated or failed assays.

Usage

call_genotypes(snpmatrix, learn = FALSE, maxiter = 50)

snp_outliers(genotypes)

Arguments

snpmatrix

Matrix of beta-values for SNP probes. Provide SNP probes as rows and samples as columns.

learn

Logical. If TRUE, model parameters are learned from the dataset using the EM algorithm. If FALSE (default), predefined model parameters are used. The predefined parameters are recommended for small datasets or datasets containing many outliers.

maxiter

Maximum number of iterations of the EM algorithm. Only used if learn = TRUE.

genotypes

Output of call_genotypes().

Value

For call_genotypes(), a list containing:

snps

The input snpmatrix.

outliers

A matrix of a-posteriori probabilities of each SNP observation being an outlier.

gamma

A list of three matrices containing the a-posteriori probabilities for each of the three genotypes (AA, AB, BB) respectively.

par

Parameters of the mixture model (class priors pi, Beta distribution parameters shapes1 and shapes2, and outlier prior alpha).

loglik

Log-likelihood in each iteration of the EM algorithm (NULL if learn = FALSE).

For snp_outliers(), a numeric vector with one outlier score per sample (average log2 odds of SNP observations being outliers). High values indicate contaminated or failed samples.

See also

check_snp_agreement and enumerate_sample_donors for using the called genotypes to track samples.
